title: Math & Modern ML (research-grade)
tagline: A full path from zero: foundations, classical ML, evaluation, neural nets, then research-grade math and modern ML for ISI/IEEE papers.

topics.title: Linear algebra
topics.summary: The language of embeddings, attention and every tensor op.
items: Vectors, norms, dot product, cosine similarity
Matrices as linear maps, matmul, transpose, inverse
Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, SVD, low-rank approximation (why LoRA works)
PCA and its relation to SVD
Orthogonality, projections, basis, rank
Tensor shapes and broadcasting (NumPy/PyTorch)
questions: Why does cosine similarity work for embeddings and when does it not?
Explain LoRA in terms of low-rank matrices.

topics.title: Calculus and optimization
items: Partial derivatives, gradient, Jacobian, Hessian
Chain rule and backpropagation by hand
Gradient descent, SGD, momentum, RMSProp, Adam, AdamW
Learning rate schedules: warmup, cosine decay
Convexity, saddle points, local minima in high dimensions
Regularization: L1, L2, weight decay, dropout
Vanishing and exploding gradients, gradient clipping
questions: Derive backprop for a two-layer MLP.
Why AdamW over Adam with L2?
Why do transformers need LR warmup?

topics.title: Probability and statistics
topics.summary: Needed for sampling, evals, A/B tests and uncertainty.
items: Random variables, expectation, variance, covariance
Common distributions: Bernoulli, Gaussian, categorical, Poisson
Bayes rule, MLE vs MAP
Entropy, cross-entropy, KL divergence, perplexity
Law of large numbers, CLT, confidence intervals, bootstrap
Hypothesis testing, p-values, power, multiple comparisons
A/B testing design, sample size, sequential testing pitfalls
Sampling: temperature, top-k, top-p, min-p, beam search
Calibration and uncertainty estimation
questions: Why is cross-entropy the right loss for classification?
How many samples do you need to detect a 2% improvement in an eval?
What does temperature do mathematically?

topics.title: Classical machine learning
topics.summary: Often the right answer in production. Always the right baseline.
items: Supervised vs unsupervised vs self-supervised vs RL
Linear and logistic regression
Trees, random forests, gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM)
SVM and kernel idea
k-means, GMM, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN
Bias-variance trade-off, overfitting, cross-validation
Metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, log loss
Imbalanced data: resampling, class weights, threshold tuning
Feature engineering, leakage, train/serve skew
Recommender basics: collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, two-tower
Time series basics and forecasting baselines
scikit-learn pipelines
questions: When would you pick gradient boosting over a neural network?
Explain data leakage with an example.
Precision vs recall: how do you choose a threshold?

topics.title: Data wrangling and analysis
topics.summary: Most real work is data work.
items: NumPy, pandas, Polars
SQL: joins, window functions, CTEs, query plans, indexing
EDA and visualization (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly)
Data quality checks, schema validation, drift detection
Labeling workflows, inter-annotator agreement, guidelines
Synthetic data generation and its failure modes
Dataset versioning and lineage
questions: Write a SQL query for the 7-day rolling average per user.
How do you detect that production data drifted from training data?

topics.title: Research-grade math toolkit
topics.summary: Notation and derivations papers assume you know.
items: Matrix calculus: gradients/Jacobians/Hessians, vec/trace identities, shape discipline
SVD, eigen, spectral norm, condition number, Eckart-Young, pseudo-inverse
Probability: Bayes, MLE/MAP, exponential family, Fisher information, Jensen/Hoeffding
Information theory: entropy, cross-entropy, KL (forward vs reverse), mutual information, InfoNCE
Optimization theory: convexity, smoothness, convergence rates, SGD noise, Adam, schedules
Learning theory: bias-variance, PAC/Rademacher, double descent, PAC-Bayes, NTK intuition
questions: Derive PCA, softmax-CE gradient, the ELBO and the Adam bias correction from scratch.
Prove KL is non-negative and explain forward vs reverse KL.

topics.title: Modern ML (not classical)
topics.summary: Transformers, self-supervised, generative, RL and alignment.
items: Attention/transformer math, normalization, positional encodings, FlashAttention
Scaling laws, compute-optimal training, emergent abilities and their critiques
Self-supervised/contrastive learning, representation collapse
Generative models: VAE/ELBO, GAN, diffusion/score matching, flows, autoregressive
Policy gradient, PPO, RLHF, DPO, reward hacking
Bayesian deep learning, ensembles, calibration, uncertainty
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA), quantization, distillation
Interpretability and robustness basics
questions: Compare PPO-RLHF and DPO.
Why does diffusion training reduce to noise prediction?
resources: Original papers: Attention Is All You Need, DDPM, PPO, DPO, Chinchilla

topics.title: Research methods & publishing (ISI / IEEE)
topics.summary: Read papers fast, design sound experiments, write and publish.
items: 3-pass paper reading, notation tables, claim vs evidence audit
Experiment design: baselines, ablations, seeds, splits, leakage checks
Statistics: CI, paired bootstrap, Welch t, Wilcoxon, Friedman, multiple-comparison correction, power
Reproducibility: seeds, configs, versions, released code, results from scripts
LaTeX + IEEEtran, BibTeX, figures/tables that stand alone
Journal selection (Web of Science/Scopus, scope, impact), cover letter, peer review, rebuttal
Research ethics: plagiarism, data licences, AI-use disclosure, limitations
questions: A reviewer says your gain is within noise - what do you do?
What goes in an ablation study?

topics.title: Complete math reference (linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics, optimisation)
topics.summary: Every named topic of the university syllabus, one checklist.
items: Vector spaces, basis, dimension, rank, null space, rank-nullity
Determinant, inverse, trace, norms (l1, l2, Frobenius, spectral), distances (Mahalanobis, cosine)
Projections, orthogonal matrices, Gram-Schmidt, QR, LU, Cholesky, eigen-decomposition, SVD, NMF
Positive (semi-)definite matrices and the spectral theorem; condition number
Limits, continuity, derivatives, chain rule, partial derivatives, gradient, directional derivative
Jacobian, Hessian, Taylor series, maxima/minima/saddles, convexity
Integration, change of variables, Monte Carlo; divergence, curl, Laplacian
Probability axioms, conditional probability, Bayes, independence, joint/marginal/conditional
PMF/PDF/CDF, expectation, variance, covariance, correlation; key discrete and continuous distributions
Law of large numbers, central limit theorem, concentration inequalities, MLE, MAP
Descriptive and inferential statistics, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, p-values, power
z/t/chi-square tests, ANOVA, Pearson/Spearman correlation, Bayesian statistics, bootstrap
Convex sets/functions, gradient descent family, Newton, quasi-Newton, L-BFGS, conjugate gradient
Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions, duality, constrained optimisation, learning-rate scheduling
questions: Why is a covariance matrix positive semi-definite?
Derive Newton's update from the Taylor expansion.
Zero correlation vs independence: give a counterexample.
resources: Mathematics for Machine Learning (Deisenroth et al.)
